decisions.statement: A body put in a test's scratch root goes through one spelling giving back git's own id.
A scratch root is swept when the test file that set the scratch root up ends pass or fail.
A scratch root sits under `/var/tmp` named here and never asked of the system.
The place the system points at is a tmpfs cut from the memory the machine runs on.
A shared tmpfs is no scratch disk.
Filling a shared tmpfs takes the whole machine down with the shared tmpfs.
The place scratch sits in is spelled once here.
Every scratch root the command system takes is taken from that place.
A body read back out of a test's scratch root is empty where no file is there.

definition: the scratch root a test sets up, the bodies it puts there, and the sweep that takes it
